name: hive
description: Mosaic of the Claude Code sessions in the hive, with a real terminal in every tile.

scripts.onboarding:try: HIVE_HOME=$(mktemp -d /tmp/hive-sandbox.XXXX) HIVE_SANDBOX=1 HIVE_NO_SWEEP=1 PORT=8791 sh -c 'node build.mjs && node ./server.mjs'
scripts.package: npm run deps:server && npm run stamp && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.package-release: npm run deps:server && npm run stamp && npm run build && electron-builder --mac zip dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package-linux: npm run deps:server && npm run stamp && npm run build && npm run pty-linux && electron-builder --linux dir
scripts.package-release-linux: npm run deps:server && npm run stamp && npm run build && npm run pty-linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage rpm --x64 --publish never
scripts.package-rpm: npm run deps:server && npm run stamp && npm run build && npm run pty-linux && electron-builder --linux rpm --x64 --publish never
scripts.package-win: npm run deps:server && npm run stamp && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.package-release-win: npm run deps:server && npm run stamp && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hive uses the microphone only when you press the microphone button in a chat or record a meeting, to turn what is said into text. The sound is transcribed on this machine and never leaves it.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Hive listens to the computer's sound only while you record a meeting, to write down the other side of the call. The sound is transcribed on this machine and never leaves it.
